summary: Top-bar activity pill opens a short task popdown instead of navigating to Tasks; Open Tasks keeps the full page. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Operators open a short task list from the activity pill; navigate guide documents the popdown and Open Tasks.

api.reason: Controller presentation only; task data already comes from inventory and existing operations.

roadmap.reason: Console interaction polish; no phase gate moves.

state.reason: No durable state; the popdown reads the same host-reported operations the Tasks page shows.

verification.method: npm --prefix web test (activity.test.mjs); npm --prefix web run typecheck; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_repository_privacy.py'. Live browser click-through of the popdown not run in this change.
